thread:
Alex Kim: Quick ask — we need a single explainer diagram + 3 social tiles for the microlaunch next Wed. Focus: benchmark narrative + inbound routing flow. Low-effort, high clarity. Can design take this?
Priya Nair: Yep. Who's the audience and CTA? also need file sizes / aspect ratios.
Alex Kim: Audience = PLG engineers & platform leads. CTA = sign up for the demo + 'Request a dedicated trial' link. Sizes: 1200x628 hero, 1080x1080 tile, 1080x1920 story. Keep brand voice technical + practical.
Jules: Marking as P1 for launch creative. @DesignBot can you pick a template (diagram + three tile variants) and mock by EOD Tuesday? :eyes:
DesignBot: auto-checklist:
- use brand palette v3
- include inference cost/latency callout (compact)
- diagram: inbound lead routing (web -> hubspot -> sales queue)
- export: PNG + SVG + Figma link
- sizes: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 1080x1920
- accessibility: 4.5:1 contrast
Ben T.: Copy suggestions for tiles: 1) "Production-grade inference, fraction of the cost" 2) "Latency SLOs that scale" 3) "Pin models, route traffic, save on tokens" CTA: "Book a demo" / link to /demo-request.
Priya Nair: For the diagram, we need explicit routing labels: hosted API -> fallback to ded. capacity -> private deploy. Also show webhook -> HubSpot form mapping. Can you include a tiny legend for SLA tiers?
Alex Kim: Yes, show routing by policy: latency-first vs cost-first. Keep it simple — 3 boxes max + arrows.
DesignBot: Draft plan attached (Figma): https://figma.mock/redwood/microlaunch-routing-draft (placeholder). Will use stacked boxes + color-coded lanes (blue = latency-first, green = cost-first, purple = private).
Jules: @Ben T. can you paste the HubSpot form endpoint and mapping snippet here so design can show route labels?
Ben T.: Sure — snippet (for visual only):
```
POST /hubspot/forms/v1/submissions HTTP/1.1
Host: api.hubapi.com
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "formId": "abc-123-microlaunch",
  "fields": [{"name":"email","value":"{{email}}"},{"name":"company","value":"{{company}}"}]
}
```
Ben T.: Also recommend adding a small note: "Leads routed to enterprise queue if company size > 500" — keeps sales routing explicit.
Priya Nair: Approving the copy. Design, keep the benchmark stat callout short — e.g., "2x throughput at 30% lower token cost" (we'll finalize metric after ops confirms).
DesignBot: Will mock 3 tile variations: stats-led, product-led, and trust-led. Export ready files and share figma link by Tue 4pm PST.
Alex Kim: Thanks — can we also get one version with brand-compliant dark background and one light? We may need both for social.
Jules: Noted. Design: prioritize light version, then dark.
DesignBot: Understood. Tagging resources: /brand/guidelines_v3.pdf, /marketing/launch-brief-2234.pdf.
Ben T.: I'll ping ops to confirm metric numbers and post final form id.
Priya Nair: Thanks team. If anything blocks, post here. :thumbsup:
